reviews_5s: Clean looking design, and so efficient in function. I am replacing a tool I think was made from zinc. It was blunt by comparison so wasn't nearly so clean or efficient. This even works for fresh chops like parsley or Rosemary from the garden. Rinses or brushes clean. It's best with dry grinding however, like cinnamon or peppercorns. Perfect size for my needs and good quality. I expect this will last even longer than my old one.amazing quality ! worth every cent 10/10This grinder looks great and has a real feel of quality with its machined Aluminum finish. My wife thinks it looks like something from Hellraiser. More importantly, it does a decent job at grinding spices. You need to work with modest quantities, but you can still fit quite a bit of unground spice into the main part of the grinder and tilt it to one side to feed into the mechanism itself, that was it works very well.WOW . . . I was really blown away when I received this Golden grinder. First off, besides looking so awesome, it functions so well and does the exact job that I need. The precision that this grinder has is amazing. It was tooled with precision and therefore has a high functionality! The price is just insane because you would expect to spend much more for this grinder. Very happy I made the right decision to buy this grinder over others out there on Amazon.The best grinder I've ever had never gums up or gets cloggedGrinds smoothly, with slightly varying hole sizes for coarser grinds (towards the edge) or finer (closer to the middle), though I'd say it overall tends somewhat towards the coarser overall, which was what I was looking for. Despite the "three in one" name, it's made of four pieces - the top and bottom of the grinder itself, the bottom, and also an optional mesh layer that very fine particular matter can pass through if you need to separate that (known in some circles and contexts as a "kief catcher"). It's easy to use and clean, turns pretty smoothly, and so far it pretty effectively tears up anything put into it with just a few twists. No complaints, really!Great grinder works wellGreat for my herbs. Not too big, but big enough. HeheSmooth grinder and very clean and cute!Best grinder ever
reviews_1s:
Terrible, don't waste your money-I purchased this thinking it was the Yatsar grinder-sadly not the quality of the yatsar - this one seizes up and I'm throwing it away.
Yatsar is the one that works great.
Update for this review-3/14/25, I am very impressed with the seller-they reached out to me and offered to give me a refund which is excellent customer service! so thank you! If you get a new improved design I would gladly purchase it.Make sure you know what kind of “spice” you’re grinding.Literally the first day I got it. The lid sealed onto itself. There aren’t any grips to get it off. It was completely unusable. Waste of money.What I do not love about this model is that it does not have a lowest level to catch bits after grinding. It was my mistake for not seeing that this did not have the extra compartment but I figured with this size, how could it not have one. I was wrong so I did return the item and the return was handled very easily. Thank you!This is drug paraphernalia not a spice grinder.I'm happy with this grinder but the bottom part that holds the ground product tends to stick. Mine is so stuck I cannot get it opened. When you grind clockwise it tends to tighten the bottom. I have tried a jar opener and heat to get it opened again without any luck. Heading out now to return it to the UPS store!
